outcome: Healthcare contact due to decreased fetal movements
cohort: 26,485 women giving birth from 32 weeks' gestation in Sweden.
finding: Raising awareness about fetal movements through Mindfetalness decreased the rate of cesarean sections, labor inductions, and small-for-gestational age babies, while increasing healthcare contact due to decreased fetal movements.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections and labor inductions were reduced in the Mindfetalness group.
